# Incident Report Template

Open one for every S0 or S1 and for any provider outage. Keep it factual and blameless; it is evidence for sign-off.

- Reference / severity (S0-S3):
- Detected (time, how: alert, user report, monitor):
- Declared by and incident owner:
- Systems and territories affected:
- Personal data involved? (yes/no; if yes, the data protection owner was told at: ):

## Timeline (UTC)

| Time | Event | By |
| --- | --- | --- |
| | | |

## Impact

Who was affected, for how long, what they could not do, and any data lost, duplicated or wrongly shown.

## Cause

What failed and why. Include the correlation id and the audit or job references.

## Resolution and recovery

What stopped it, what restored service, how recovery was verified (health, Job Console, records checked).

## Prevention

| Action | Owner | Due | Tracked in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| | | | |

## Communication

Who was told, when, and what they were told (franchisees, advertisers, parents, regulator if required).
